sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Heightened Smell · Use Perception 18 when relying on smell.

Pounce · Move at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hit it with Claws on the same turn. It makes a DC 14 STR save or falls prone. The tiger can then use a bonus action to make one Claws attack against the prone creature.

lines: Multiattack · Make one Bite and one Claws attack.

sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Accustomed to Filth · Has advantage on saves against contracting diseases.
Heightened Smell · Use Perception 15 when relying on smell.
Swarm · Can share spaces in both directions with other creatures. Passes through gaps large enough for a Tiny rat. Cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Bites · A creature hit must make a DC 9 CON save. On failure, the GM chooses Rat Plague or poisoning until the end of the target’s next turn. The short poisoning option is complete in v0.2.

Rat Plague (v0.1 supplement) · If using the earlier publisher sidebar, the victim is poisoned and regains HP only by magic until cured. Repeat this bite’s CON save every 24 hours. Success cures the disease. Failure lowers maximum HP by 3 (1d6). The loss ends after a long rest once cured, and reaching 0 maximum HP kills the victim. Rats are immune to the disease’s effects.

Encounter habitat suggestions draw on the equivalent animal in Monster Manual (2024).
Swarm Resilience supplies the listed damage resistances and condition immunities.

The v0.2 Rat Plague option points to a Diseased Rats sidebar absent from this . The separately labeled supplement summarizes the publisher’s v0.1 sidebar. The v0.2 fallback is the listed short poisoning option.
Kobold Press, Black Flag Roleplaying Reference Document v0.2, p. 367.
